items.q: Cross eyed 3 year old straightening fully with hypermetropic glasses has what?
o: Fully accommodative esotropia managed with glasses
items.exp: Uncorrected plus drives convergence; full cycloplegic correction with bifocal debates for high AC/A ratios preserves binocularity while surgery waits for residual angles.

items.q: Parks 3 step test positive (hypertropic eye, worse contralateral gaze, worse ipsilateral tilt) isolates which palsy?
items.exp: Superior oblique depresses intorted eyes; tilt dependency separates from skew and thyroid while trauma (trochlear) and congenital (large vertical fusional reserves) histories guide.
items.kp: Three tilts to the fourth: superior oblique.

items.q: Child closing one eye in bright sunlight with intermittent outward drift has what and course?
o: Intermittent exotropia observing then operating for lost control
items.exp: Divergence excess breaks fusion outdoors; patching and minus therapy temporise while deteriorating Newcastle scores schedule bilateral lateral rectus recession.
items.kp: Sunlight winker drifting out: intermittent exo.

items.q: Esotropia worse on lateral gaze with face turn toward affected side is which palsy?
items.exp: Abduction failure doubles horizontally maximally toward palsy; raised pressure, tumours and vasculitis hunt follows while prisms bridge recovery and surgery waits a year.
items.kp: Cannot look out, face turns out: sixth.

items.q: Amblyopia patching is effective chiefly before which age and why?
o: About 7 to 8 years close of critical cortical plasticity
items.exp: Pruning fixes deprived cortex permanently after plasticity wanes; hours dosed by depth with atropine alternatives while reverse amblyopia watches the good eye.
items.kp: Lazy eye patches before eight or never.

items.q: Atropine penalisation treats amblyopia by which mechanism?
o: Blurring good eye near vision forcing lazy eye use
items.exp: Weekend drops suit mild moderate amblyopia with better compliance than patches; glasses precede while follow up guards good eye acuity.
items.kp: Blur the good eye to teach the lazy one.

items.q: Spasmus nutans triad in infant with head nodding comprises what and course?
o: Nystagmus with head nodding and torticollis, benign but imaging selected cases
items.exp: Fine asymmetric nystagmus with compensatory nodding resolves by school age; chiasmal glioma mimics mandate MRI when atypical (pallor, large head, neurofibromatosis).
items.kp: Nodding nystagmus infant: nutans, image the odd.

items.q: Downbeat nystagmus localises to which region and needs what?
items.exp: Cerebellar tonsil ectopia drives downbeat with ataxia and headache; decompression debates follow while drugs (magnesium, lithium patterns) bridge.
items.kp: Eyes beating down: scan the junction.

items.q: DVD (dissociated vertical deviation) associates with which squint and managed how?
o: Infantile esotropia; observe unless cosmetically disabling then recess
items.exp: Non fixating eye drifts up with extorsion on cover; asymmetric surgery addresses while glasses and amblyopia therapy precede. Bielschowsky head tilt differentiates.
items.kp: Covered eye floating up: DVD of infantile eso.

items.q: Duane retraction syndrome is distinguished by which motility pattern?
o: Abduction deficit with globe retraction and fissure narrowing on attempted adduction
items.exp: Aberrant innervation co contracts recti retracting globe; face turn compensates while recession with transposition suits disabling deviation. Wiring errors (female predominance, left eye) mark congenital.
items.kp: Eye pulling back looking in: Duane.
